ai.overview: The Vancouver Goldeneyes put their Belt Holders championship on the line when they host the Seattle Torrent on December 5th, 2026. Vancouver has defended the belt twice in this reign and enters riding a five-game winning streak, while Seattle has never held the belt in their history. This marks the first time these teams will meet with the lineal championship at stake.
key_matchups: Vancouver's perfect 4-0 all-time record against Seattle, including two wins already this season by scores of 6-5 and 4-1
Vancouver's five-game winning streak against Seattle coming off a 1-2 loss to Montréal
Home ice advantage for the Goldeneyes, who have won both previous meetings at their venue by 4-1 margins
ai.betting_angles: Vancouver holds every advantage in this matchup: a five-game winning streak, perfect 4-0 all-time dominance over Seattle, and home ice where they've twice beaten the Torrent 4-1. Seattle is coming off a 1-2 loss and has never solved Vancouver, losing twice this season including a 6-5 thriller and a 4-1 decision. The Elo model favors Vancouver, which aligns with the historical data showing complete Goldeneyes supremacy in this matchup.
ai.prediction_writeup: Vancouver's perfect record against Seattle speaks volumes, and their current form only reinforces their edge. The Goldeneyes have won five straight games overall and all four meetings with the Torrent, never losing to them in franchise history. While two of their recent wins over Seattle were close (4-3 and 6-5), Vancouver also posted convincing 4-1 victories both at home and on the road. Seattle's 1-2 loss to Montréal in their most recent outing suggests they're not clicking offensively, making it hard to see them breaking through against a hot Vancouver squad defending their belt at home.
